description: This file defines the TracingDispatcher class, which manages tracing operations within a browser context or API request context in the Playwright server. It includes methods to start, stop, and group tracing chunks, and handles external dependencies such as ArtifactDispatcher and Dispatcher, as well as protocol channels.

classes.name: TracingDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class responsible for managing tracing activities such as starting, stopping, and chunking trace data within a browser context or API request context.

methods.name: from
methods.description: A static method to retrieve an existing TracingDispatcher instance from the scope or create a new one.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new TracingDispatcher with a given scope and tracing object.

methods.name: tracingStart
methods.description: Starts the tracing process with provided parameters and progress indicator.

methods.name: tracingStartChunk
methods.description: Starts a new tracing chunk and returns its result.

methods.name: tracingGroup
methods.description: Creates a new group within tracing, with a name and optional location.

methods.name: tracingStopChunk
methods.description: Stops the current tracing chunk and returns artifacts and entries.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the dispatcher is disposed, ensuring tracing chunks are properly finalized.

ctags.name: TracingDispatcher
ctags.pattern: /^export class TracingDispatcher extends Dispatcher<Tracing, channels.TracingChannel, BrowserConte/

ctags.name: artifact
ctags.pattern: /^    const { artifact, entries } = await this._object.stopChunk(progress, params);$/

ctags.name: entries
ctags.pattern: /^    const { artifact, entries } = await this._object.stopChunk(progress, params);$/
